items.why_en: This specialized agent for code optimization generates and iterates optimized code, crucial for improving game engine algorithms and overall code efficiency.

items.name: Godot AI Assistant Hub 2.0
items.why: 作為 Godot 編輯器的開源插件，它直接將 AI 整合到遊戲引擎中，支援程式碼生成、場景編輯和資產創建，對 Godot 遊戲開發者極具價值。

items.name: AlphaEvolve
items.why: AlphaEvolve是一個基於Gemini的代碼優化和發現代理，旨在解決複雜的算法問題，並在物流、半導體和金融服務等領域實現突破，是強大的數據推理和模擬工具。
items.why_en: AlphaEvolve is a code optimization and discovery agent built on Gemini, designed to solve complex algorithmic problems and achieve breakthroughs in domains like logistics, semiconductors, and financial services, making it a powerful data reasoning and simulation tool.

items.name: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge

monthly.note_en: Fewer than 5 officially released (GA) game module creation tools were launched this month (July 2026) and recently (last 30-60 days), so only 4 are listed.

items.name: Meshy Smart Topology (meshy-t2)
items.why: Meshy 推出新的 Smart Topology 模型類型，提供更清晰的拓撲結構、原生分離部件和可控的多邊形數量，顯著提升 3D 模型生成品質。
items.why_en: Meshy launched a new Smart Topology model type, offering cleaner topology, natively separated parts, and controllable polygon counts, significantly improving 3D model generation quality.

items.name: Rodin Gen-2.5
items.why: Rodin Gen-2.5 帶來雕塑級的幾何細節、自適應的速度-品質控制和 3D 原生紋理，提升了生產級 3D 資產的生成能力。
items.why_en: Rodin Gen-2.5 introduces sculpt-level geometric detail, adaptive speed-quality controls, and 3D-native texturing, enhancing the generation of production-ready 3D assets.

items.name: Meshy Auto Split
items.why: Meshy 推出 Auto Split 功能，可在數秒內自動分割 3D 模型，使其更易於 3D 列印和下游工作流程。
items.why_en: Meshy launched the Auto Split feature, automatically segmenting 3D models in seconds, making them easier for 3D printing and downstream workflows.

items.name: Tripo AI Texture Quality (Extreme)
items.why: Tripo AI 為其現有模型增加了「極致」紋理品質選項，顯著提升了生成 3D 模型的紋理解析度和細節。
items.why_en: Tripo AI added an 'Extreme' texture quality option for its existing models, significantly enhancing the texture resolution and detail of generated 3D models.

overall.name: Meshy-6 Auto-Rig + Animate
overall.why: 一站式,<30 秒自動綁人形/四足,500+ 預設動作
overall.why_en: One-stop; auto-rigs humanoids/quadrupeds in <30s, 500+ preset animations

overall.name: Autodesk Flow Studio AI Rigging
overall.why: AI 自動關節 + AI 動捕,匯出 Maya/Blender/UE
overall.why_en: AI auto-joints + AI mocap; export to Maya/Blender/UE

overall.name: Tripo Auto-Rigging (Uni-Rig)
overall.why: 自動骨架 + 權重 + 自動動畫,風格化佳
overall.why_en: Auto-skeleton + weights + auto-animation; great for stylized

overall.name: Cascadeur 2026.1
overall.why: AI AutoPosing/Physics + AI Root Motion,UE Live Link
overall.why_en: AI AutoPosing/Physics + AI Root Motion; UE Live Link

overall.name: Anything World — Animate Anything
overall.why: 任意靜態網格 AI 綁定(尤其動物/生物)
overall.why_en: AI-rig any static mesh (esp. animals/creatures)

items.name: Meshy Auto-rigging & Animation API
items.why: 本月正式發佈的自動綁骨與動畫 API，進一步強化其 3D 角色可動化能力。
items.why_en: Officially released Auto-rigging & Animation API this month, further enhancing its 3D character animation capabilities.

items.name: V2Fun
items.why: 作為整合式 AI 3D 模型生成平台，本月更新強調其自動綁骨與動畫工作流程。
items.why_en: As an integrated AI 3D model generation platform, this month's update highlights its auto-rigging and animation workflow.

items.name: Reallusion AI Studio
items.why: Reallusion 專為 3D 藝術家推出的全新 AI 創作工作流程，包含角色綁骨功能。
items.why_en: Reallusion's new AI creation workflow built for 3D artists, including character rigging capabilities.

items.name: RigSnap
items.why: Blender 新增工具，可自動修復因角色比例變化而產生的綁骨問題。
items.why_en: New Blender addon that automatically fixes rigging issues caused by changes in character proportions.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio AI Rigging
items.why: Autodesk 在本月再次強調其 AI 綁骨功能，簡化 3D 角色從模型到動畫的流程。
items.why_en: Autodesk re-emphasized its AI Rigging feature this month, streamlining the 3D character workflow from model to animation.

monthly.note: 本月(2026 年 7 月)未發現廣為人知且已正式發佈的 AI 工具組合。此列表由最近期(2026 年 6 月)的發佈補足。

items.why_en: Deep integration of Claude Fable 5 and GitHub Copilot Enterprise for a more powerful AI-assisted coding and deployment experience.

items.why_en: Launched a new custom agent framework, allowing enterprise users to integrate multiple top LLMs to build proprietary AI agents.

items.why_en: Integrated the latest Midjourney V7 with other top AI tools to create a one-stop visual, audio, and video content creation workflow.

items.name: Raycast AI + Gemini 3.5 Flash + Perplexity AI (Desktop Productivity Suite)
items.why: 強化 Raycast AI 與 Gemini 3.5 Flash 和 Perplexity AI 的整合, 提升桌面搜尋、指令和資訊獲取效率。
items.why_en: Enhanced Raycast AI integration with Gemini 3.5 Flash and Perplexity AI for improved desktop search, commands, and information retrieval efficiency.
